denominator_contract: Every id in required_case_ids must exist in testdata/ddl-golden/T10.json or in a named unit/e2e test. Removing a case, loosening an expectation, or shrinking the denominator without amending this file is a contract violation.

fixtures.t: CREATE TABLE t (a INT, b INT, c VARCHAR(64), j JSON, KEY idx_c(b)); — ordinary visible secondary index, vouched set
fixtures.tp: CREATE TABLE tp (a INT, b INT, PRIMARY KEY (a), KEY idx_b(b)); — vouched primary key for PRIMARY-target cells
fixtures.tinv: CREATE TABLE tinv (a INT, KEY idx_i(a)); ALTER TABLE tinv ALTER INDEX idx_i INVISIBLE; — catalog-proven invisible member (8.0+/TiDB only)
fixtures.tsp: CREATE TABLE tsp (g GEOMETRY NOT NULL SRID 0, b VARCHAR(64)); CREATE SPATIAL INDEX idx_sp ON tsp(g); CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX idx_ft ON tsp(b); — provider kind-fidelity fixture (mysql80/84 only; 5.7 spatial uses ALTER-free spatial create)

notes: Every gap must attribute to its owning rule and facts — no universal notice, no universal unsupported.
VISIBLE direction and ordinary indexes are explicit no-finding controls, not absent cases.
mysql57 keeps coverage of the ALTER INDEX form through the version_inapplicable result, never silent complete.
expression semantics stay unaudited: the expr/multi_valued aspects remain — T10 adds version applicability, not expression inspection.
